package.description: A private AI companion for your Mac and Windows that reads your notes and keeps your plans honest.

en-US.description: A private AI companion for your Mac and Windows that reads your notes and keeps your plans honest.
en-US.longDescription: Yachito is an AI companion that lives on your computer, reads your plain-markdown notebook, prepares morning briefs from your real plans, and helps you decide what matters today. On Windows, Yachito is currently invite-only and requires an invite code to pair an account. When configured with a cloud model such as Claude or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, the context needed for a request is sent to that provider; a local model can keep processing on-device. Calendar, reminders, and dictation are macOS-only for now.
en-US.name: Yachito
